description:
• Fixed the overfitting problem in previous versions.

  • Even larger training dataset (6,617 images)

  • Auto tagged with wd-v1-4-moat-tagger-v2 with zero pruning.

  • Used flip augmentation and color augmentation.

  • Used multi resolution noise during training.

  • Obtained from LoCon extraction after fine-tuning the entire model.

  • Downscaled the LoCon dimension to 128.
